comparison.objective: Gauge seven blocks with ordered GO/NO-GO checks and sort them; candidate tunes and validates a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR requires repeated part alignment to two precision gaps, hands-off fit observation, classification, and sorting. Candidate requires fine tool insertion, collar locking, and iterative dynamic-response adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires valid ordered gauge checks and all blocks in correct trays, with strong penalties for escapes and false rejects. Candidate requires two consecutive safe stop cycles within energy, travel, velocity, force, rebound, and drift constraints.
comparison.reason: Both use physical measurement to guide action, but dimensional classification/sorting and dynamic mechanism commissioning test different abilities.
